beats.text: The stack is massive: $1,000 to $25,000 in Claude or OpenAI credits, $7,500 in Lambda GPU power via NVIDIA, and a full year of the Fin AI pro tier for free.

beats.text: Eligibility is simple: under 50 employees, a functional product, and a professional email domain. No VC backing required—this is pure developer access.
Step one: Go to fin.ai/learn/ai-credits-for-startups. Step two: Apply at claude.com for your API tokens. Step three: Sign up for Groq and Deepgram for instant zero-cost testing.
